title: Implicit Priors Editing in Stable Diffusion via Targeted Token Adjustment

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from under-specified professional prompts (e.g., "A CEO") and evaluating the gender presentation of the generated figures using a CLIP ViT-B/32 zero-shot text-based classifier. The bias is measured by calculating the percentage of female versus male figures generated, with the goal of achieving an equal 50/50 representation.
